title: GitHub availability report: October 2026
summary:
In October, we experienced eight incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services.

The post GitHub availability report: October 2026 appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
llm_summary: In October 2026 GitHub experienced eight separate incidents that caused degraded performance across its services. While most users only noticed brief slowdowns, the outages highlighted the platform’s ongoing challenges in maintaining uninterrupted availability. The full details are available in GitHub’s October availability report.
